title: Google AI Fundamentals
description: Those who earn the AI Fundamentals badge from Google have adopted the "AI as a Collaborator" mindset and developed an understanding of the AI ecosystem, including models, features, and applications. They are familiar with AI strengths, limitations and risks. They have mastered prompting and have practiced advanced techniques. They have demonstrated the ability to use AI responsibly by applying the ACT framework (Ask, Check, Tell) to evaluate outputs for accuracy, bias, and privacy risks.

title: Google AI Essentials V1
description: Demonstrated competence in integrating generative AI tools into workplace tasks, writing effective prompts, and applying AI responsibly.

title: Developer Profession - Level 3: Expert
description: Expert level recognition within the IBM Developer Profession, demonstrating mastery in software development practices, architecture, and technical leadership.

title: Enterprise Design Thinking Practitioner
description: Practical application of Enterprise Design Thinking to solve complex problems at scale, focusing on user outcomes and cross-functional collaboration.

title: IBM Carbon Design System Developer Essentials - React
description: Essential knowledge and skills for building accessible, high-quality user interfaces using the IBM Carbon Design System with React.

title: IBM Cloud Kubernetes Service
description: Understanding core concepts of Kubernetes on IBM Cloud, including container orchestration, pods, resources, and architectural models.

title: IBM Agile Explorer
description: Exploration and application of Agile principles and values to improve teamwork, efficiency, and delivery of user value.
